propositions: The transition library param must change from split force(bool) + force_close + reason to unified force(str|None=None) matching claim's audit-reason-carrying interface
Bare --force and --force=<reason> must yield identical behavior across transition and claim CLIs, both mapping to force_reason in-memory while retaining persisted force_close_reason key
The transition CLI --reason flag must no longer serve as a fallback force-bypass note; it feeds only close_reason, and --force alone carries the audit reason
Legacy calls to rebar.transition(force_close=) or rebar.transition(force=True) must warn via _deprecations and map to the new force string parameter

All internal spellings of the force-bypass concept (force_reason, force_close, force_plan_review) must unify to force_reason across transition and claim computation, while persisted status_data key name remains unchanged for reducer back-compat
Guidance strings in gates.py, txn.py, and transition.py must show only --force[=<reason>] pattern with no transition --force --reason= or --reason-as-force-note wording
